module: Class of a race path checkpoint (pathnode): a sphere with radius and optional normal, positioned manually or on a navgraph node. Handles the recovery zones (recovery/reverseRecovery), side padding (sidePadding), custom fields, associated road points and the generation of scenery transforms on the sides. The module returns a factory: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/race/pathnode')(path, name, forceId).
notes: Fields: id, name, mode ('manual' or 'navgraph'), pos, normal (nil without direction), hasNormal, radius, navRadiusScale (1), visible (true), useAsSplit (true, counts as a split time), recovery and reverseRecovery (startPosition id, -1 if none), sidePadding (vec3: x = left, y = right), customFields, sortOrder.
getSideTransforms temporarily disables forest collision during its raycasts (core_forest).
getPaddedCenter uses self.normal: error if the pathnode has no normal (hasNormal false).
setNavRadiusScale reads map.getMap().nodes[navgraphName] without checking that the node exists.
onSerialize does not save the list of road points (they are recomputed).

C.desc: Race checkpoint. The angles passed to getSideTransforms are in radians.

init.desc: Constructor: id, default name "Pathnode <id>", manual mode, default field values.

setNormal.desc: Sets the normal (length > 0.9 required, then normalized, hasNormal true); otherwise clears it.

setManual.desc: Switches to manual mode with the given position, radius and normal.

setNavgraph.desc: Switches to navgraph mode: position and radius (× navRadiusScale) of the road map node, or from fallback if the node does not exist. Clears the normal.

fallback.desc: {pos, radius} used if the node is absent.

setNavRadiusScale.desc: Changes the navgraph radius scale and recomputes the radius in navgraph mode.

inside.desc: Indicates whether a point is inside the sphere (and in front of the normal's plane if hasNormal).

intersectCorners.desc: Tests whether a segment connecting a vehicle's corners crosses the pathnode: the normal's plane within the sphere if hasNormal, otherwise the sphere itself.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the pathnode (name, mode, scale, position, radius, normal, navgraphName, recovery, visible, useAsSplit, sidePadding, customFields).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the pathnode from serialized data; converts the recovery ids with oldIdMap.

getPaddedCenter.desc: Center and width of the pathnode's useful area once the sidePadding side paddings are removed.

drawDebug.desc: Draws sphere, label (prefix '*' if useAsSplit, in parentheses if invisible), numeric custom fields (if the editor preference raceEditor.general.showCustomFields is active) and normal arrows.

convertRayHitToTransform.desc: Converts the result of a raycast into a scenery object transform: position offset by zOff along the ground normal, scale, rotation according to alignMode.

returns.desc: {pos, scl, rot, side}, nil if no hit.

getSideTransforms.desc: Computes two scenery transforms, to the left and right of the pathnode, by casting rays toward the ground on each side (10 m radius). Returns an empty table if the pathnode has no normal.

posOffset.desc: Position offset (x, y lateral, z height).

rotOffset.desc: Offset Euler rotation, symmetric between the sides.

returns.desc: {leftTransform, rightTransform} (each can be nil without a hit).

setRoutePoint.desc: Stores the associated road point (vehicle tracking).

setStaticRoutePoint.desc: Stores the static road point (not modified by vehicle tracking).
